faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: How long does delivery take in Raipur?
faq.a1: Most orders arrive in 1–3 days. The product page shows the expected time and your order page shows each step.
faq.a2: Cash on delivery for now. UPI and card payments are coming soon.
faq.q3: What if the part does not fit?
faq.a3: Tell us within 7 days from your order page. After a quick check we replace it or refund you. Opened lubricants and installed batteries cannot be returned.
faq.a4: Our team calls or visits every workshop, checks its location and services, and watches its reviews.
faq.q5: Will a workshop start work without asking me?
faq.a5: No. You approve the itemised estimate line by line before any work starts.
faq.q6: Can I order in bulk for my garage or fleet?
faq.a6: Yes. Ask for a bulk price from any product page or your cart and agree the final price with our team in a chat.
faq.more: Still have a question? Ask MechDost

returns.title: Returns, refunds and faulty parts
returns.lead: Please check that a part fits your vehicle before you order. Not sure? Ask us first. We're happy to help.
returns.noReturnsBody: Products can't be returned or exchanged if you change your mind, order the wrong part or no longer need it.

returns.unfulfilledBody: If we can't confirm your order with a shop, or you cancel before it is packed, you pay nothing for cash-on-delivery orders and online payments are refunded in full.
returns.refundsBody: Refunds go back to the way you paid; for cash-on-delivery orders, to your bank account or UPI ID. We start the refund within 2 working days of approval; banks usually take 5 to 7 working days.
returns.coinsBody: Coins used on a cancelled order are given back as coins. Coins have no cash value and are never paid out as money.

privacy.lead: What we keep about you, why, who sees it, and how you stay in control. Plain words, no surprises.
privacy.whoBody: MechDost is run by {company}, {address}. We decide how your data is used and we answer for it.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, mobile number and email; a password, stored only as a scrambled code we cannot read back; delivery addresses; your vehicles and service history; your orders, bookings and support messages.
privacy.purposeBody: To deliver your orders and run your workshop bookings, to answer your support requests, to keep accounts safe from misuse, and to keep the order and tax records the law asks for. Nothing else without asking you first.
privacy.shareBody: Only the shop or workshop handling your order or booking, and only after they accept it — your number and address stay hidden until then. Order updates on WhatsApp go through Meta when you have them switched on. We never sell your data.
privacy.analyticsTitle: Analytics, only if you allow it
privacy.analyticsBody: With “Allow analytics” we count page visits and clicks to improve MechDost. These records never hold your name, number or address, and phone numbers or emails typed into search are removed first. Choose “Essential only” any time with “Privacy choices” at the bottom of every page.
privacy.safeBody: Encrypted connections everywhere, sensitive details encrypted again in our database, staff access only for the part of their job, and a log of every change staff make.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask us to show, correct or delete your data, or withdraw a permission you gave. Deletion is confirmed by our support team first; order and invoice records are kept as long as tax law requires, then removed.
privacy.help: Questions, requests or complaints about your data? Call us:

delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.lead: How your order reaches you, what you pay and when.
delivery.pinBody: Enter your PIN code to see which parts we can deliver to you, the price from the nearest shop, the delivery charge and how many days delivery takes.
delivery.pricesBody: Part prices include GST. The delivery charge is shown separately before you order, and delivery is free above the amount shown at checkout.
delivery.confirmTitle: A nearby shop confirms your order
delivery.confirmBody: We send your order to a verified shop near you. Once the shop accepts it, we tell you it is confirmed and on its way. If no shop can take it, we let you know and you pay nothing.
delivery.codeBody: When your order is out for delivery you get a 4-digit delivery code. Give it to the delivery person only when the parts are in your hands.
delivery.payBody: Pay cash on delivery for orders up to the limit shown at checkout. Online payment is coming soon; until then nothing is charged before delivery.
delivery.cancelBody: You can cancel until the shop packs your order. After that, parts can't be returned unless they are faulty, damaged or wrong; see our returns policy.
delivery.help: Questions about a delivery? Call us:

service.title: Workshop bookings
service.lead: How a booking works, and why no work starts without your approval.
service.findBody: Tell us where your vehicle is. We show verified workshops nearby; pick one, or let MechDost choose for you.
service.proposalTitle: The workshop proposes a time and cost
service.proposalBody: The workshop suggests a date, a time slot and an expected cost range. Your booking is confirmed only when you accept it.
service.estimateTitle: You approve every line of work
service.estimateBody: After checking your vehicle, the workshop sends an itemised estimate. You approve or decline each line. Work you have not approved is not done and not charged.
service.cancelBody: You can cancel a booking free of charge until the workshop has your vehicle.
service.billBody: When the work is done you get a final bill with only the work you approved, and you pay that bill.
service.pickupBody: Vehicle pickup is available only where a workshop offers it, and is agreed with the workshop for your booking. We don't offer roadside help yet.
service.help: Questions about a booking? Call us:

company.title: Company and contact
company.lead: Who runs MechDost and how to reach us.
company.complaintsBody: Call or WhatsApp us, or raise a support request from your account. We confirm that we have your complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within one month.

order.confirmed: Your MechDost order {{1}} is confirmed and will be shipped soon. Track it with the button below.
order.out_for_delivery: Your order {{1}} is out for delivery. Share delivery code {{2}} only with the delivery partner when you receive it.
order.rejected: We could not fulfil your order {{1}}. Any payment will go back to your original payment method within 5–7 working days.
order.routed: New order {{1}} for your shop. Accept or decline within {{2}} minutes in the MechDost partner portal.

service.estimate_sent: The workshop has sent an estimate for your service request {{1}}. Review and approve each item before any work starts.

ticket.replied: MechDost support replied to your request {{1}}. Open it to read the reply.

support.title: Support & requests
support.intro: Something wrong with a part or an order? Tell us here. We reply within 48 hours.
support.policyNote: We don’t take returns or exchanges. Faulty, damaged or wrong parts are replaced or refunded through a request here.
support.messageHelp: Tell us what happened. For a faulty part, say what you noticed and when.
support.err_limit: You can raise up to {max} requests a day. Reply on an existing one instead.
support.err_stale: This request just changed. Reload to see the latest.
support.empty: No requests yet. If something is wrong with an order, raise a request above.
support.inboxIntro: Requests from the website and WhatsApp. Reply within 48 hours; resolve within 30 days.
support.internalToggle: Internal note (the customer won’t see it)
support.whatsAppNote: Replies go out on WhatsApp, free within 24 hours of their last message.
support.inboxEmpty: Nothing waiting. New requests appear here.

consent.label: Privacy choice
consent.title: Your privacy choice
consent.body: We use essential storage to run the site (your cart, language and sign-in). With your permission we also count page visits and clicks — never your name, number or address — to improve MechDost. You can change this any time with “Privacy choices” at the bottom of the page.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong on this page.
errorPage.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support from the page footer.
